o1: Enables netrin receptor activity and protein tyrosine kinase binding activity. Involved in axon guidance; establishment or maintenance of actin cytoskeleton polarity; and regulation of neuron projection development. Acts upstream of or within distal tip cell migration. Located in axonal growth cone. Is expressed in distal tip cell; excretory canal; head neurons; motor neurons; and somatic nervous system. Orthologous to several human genes including UNC5A (unc-5 netrin receptor A); UNC5B (unc-5 netrin receptor B); and UNC5C (unc-5 netrin receptor C).
